newsitem.title: USA: World Bank approves $60 mln Hungary utilities loan.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $60 mln Hungary utilities loan.

text.p: The World Bank has approved a $60 million loan to boost power supplies in Hungary, the bank's press office said on Thursday.
A bank statement said its 15 year loan, which has a five-year grace period, brought total World Bank lending to Hungary to almost $4 billion since 1982.
The money will fund gas turbines providing 220 MW of extra power generation capacity to enable Hungary to meet European Union electricity supply standards, the statement added.

"This project is urgently needed to improve power supply standards," task manager Marc Heitner said. "It will benefit power consumers in Hungary and will facilitate the integration of the country into the European grid."
